user_input: Evaluate clause for risk: 'Vendor shall be the exclusive provider of technical support services to the Client for a duration of five (5) years without termination for convenience rights.'
retrieved_contexts: KB-POLICY-EXCLUSIVITY-001: Tata Group procurement guidelines strictly prohibit multi-year single-vendor exclusivity arrangements without explicit waiver from General Counsel. Exclusivity agreements exceeding 2 years are classified as HIGH RISK.
KB-POLICY-TERM-002: Contracts lacking standard termination for convenience upon 30-day notice create operational lock-in and must be flagged as HIGH RISK.
response: RISK: HIGH. Rationale: This clause creates an exclusive vendor relationship for 5 years without a termination for convenience mechanism. This directly violates Tata Group procurement policy KB-POLICY-EXCLUSIVITY-001 and KB-POLICY-TERM-002 regarding vendor lock-in exposure.
reference: RISK: HIGH. The 5-year exclusivity without convenience termination violates Tata Group procurement policies KB-POLICY-EXCLUSIVITY-001 and KB-POLICY-TERM-002 due to severe operational lock-in and restriction of alternative supplier engagement.

user_input: Evaluate clause for risk: 'Client shall pay all undisputed vendor invoices within Net 60 days of receipt. Late payments shall accrue an interest penalty of 1% per month.'
retrieved_contexts: KB-POLICY-PAYMENT-005: Standard payment terms for commercial contracts are Net 60 days. Late payment interest capped at 1% per month (12% per annum) or SOFR equivalent is acceptable and classified as LOW RISK.
response: RISK: LOW. Rationale: Net 60 payment terms and 1% monthly late penalty align with standard financial governance policies under KB-POLICY-PAYMENT-005.
reference: RISK: LOW. The Net 60 payment timeline and 1% monthly interest rate are fully compliant with Tata Group standard financial governance policy KB-POLICY-PAYMENT-005.
